title: Rebuild the credenza to match the reference
author: claude
summary: A smoked-walnut sideboard with a marble top, as in the reference.
what: The credenza now has a smoked walnut body with a reveal, push-to-open fronts (a door, two stacked drawers and another door), a marble top with lips, black sled legs, and decor.
why: It has to match the reference image.
how: The code is the `build_credenza` function in `build_room.py`. What exactly was wrong before was not written down.

tech.name: Blender
tech.plain: Free 3D software. We use it to build the room and to calculate how light falls in it.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
